newsitem.title: GERMANY: Veba - no plans for higher Degussa stake.
newsitem.headline: Veba - no plans for higher Degussa stake.

text.p: German utility Veba AG said on Wednesday it had no plans to further increase its stake in chemicals and metals group Degussa AG, after earlier announcing plans to buy a 36.4 per stake in the firm.
"We do not intend to do this, are not considering it and there is no current plan," Veba chief executive Ulrich Hartmann told Reuters
Hartmann said the stake acquired would facilitate co-operation between the two companies and strengthen the international position of Veba' chemicals unit Huels AG.
Some 15 percent of the companies' business overlapped, he said, but he did not see any significant jobs cuts resulting from the move.
Hartmann also said Veba would consider further acquisitions.
